title: Dev Showdown
subtitle: Execom Project Showcase
description: You are invited to 'Dev Showdown', a project showcase by our very own Execom members! Come and watch the teams present the exciting projects they have been working on. Discover creative and practical tech solutions, get inspiration for your future projects, and connect with the CSI technical community.
highlights: Discover creative and practical tech solutions
Get inspiration for your future projects
Learn new ideas, workflows, and approaches
Connect with the CSI technical community

title: Antigravity Unlocked
subtitle: Powered by Gemini
description: Antigravity is trending. AI is evolving. But only a few actually understand what’s coming next. Are you ready to be one of them? Join us for “Antigravity Unlocked Powered by Gemini”, a hands-on journey into the world of Agentic AI and Google’s revolutionary Antigravity framework.
highlights: Discover what Agentic AI truly means
Exciting Google swags & exclusive giveaways for winners!

title: CSI Community Connect
subtitle: The Ultimate CSI Community Meetup
description: Brace yourselves because we’re bringing the ultimate CSI COMMUNITY CONNECT! Insanely fun activities, team bonding like never before, high-energy group challenges, and pure chaos + laughter. Meet the entire CSI fam and start the year with a bang!

title: Prompt Arena
subtitle: Outsmart. Outcreate. Outprompt.
description: Think you can outsmart AI? Think you can craft prompts that stand out? This is your chance to prove it in a high-energy competition where creativity meets logic and technology! Gear up for 3 electrifying rounds, from a mind-bending Quiz to an intense Prompt Battle and a thrilling Mystery Round!
highlights: 3 Electrifying Rounds: Quiz, Prompt Battle, Mystery Round

title: Hack Revolution 2025
subtitle: Biggest Flagship Event | Powered by Aces
description: Get ready to witness the ultimate tech face-off where innovation meets impact. Brought to you by the ultimate duo CSI x E-Cell MJCET a 15-hour coding marathon designed to challenge your creativity, logic, and problem-solving like never before. Win incredible cash prizes from a massive pool of ₹3,00,000! Winners get direct entry to Smart India Hackathon 2026.
highlights: 4 Competitive Tracks: Smart Ed, Urban Tech, Agri & Open Hardware
Direct entry to SIH 2026 for winners

title: Terraview 2025: Turning Data into Stories
subtitle: The Ultimate First Year Showdown | Powered by ACES
description: Exclusively for First-Years! Step into the world of data visualization and show your mettle! This isn’t just any competition, it’s your chance to turn raw data into jaw-dropping insights. Compete for a ₹30,000 cash prize pool! This is a SOLO event - it’s just you, your data, and your vision.

title: Data Analytics using Terraview
subtitle: Turning Data into Stories
description: First Years Exclusive! Get ready to explore the world of data with Terraview, the platform that transforms raw numbers into impactful insights. Whether you’re a beginner or a curious innovator, this hands-on session will help you craft dashboards that impress and prepare for Terraview 2025 with a ₹30,000 cash prize pool!
highlights: Skills to create impactful data stories
Expert tips to shine in Terraview 2025

title: VisionVerse
subtitle: The Official Pre-Hackathon Workshop Series of Hack Revolution
description: Join us for VisionVerse an immersive workshop introducing you to Computer Vision, where machines learn to see and understand the world like humans. In the age of AI, Computer Vision is everywhere! From robotics to smart apps. Learn the skills that help machines see, think, and act. Fee: ₹50/- (Free for CSI & E-Cell Members!)
highlights: Build hands-on projects with OpenCV / Python

title: WEBVERSE
subtitle: The Official Pre-Hackathon Workshop Series Of Hackrevolution
description: CSI and E-Cell MJCET proudly bring you WEBVERSE 🌐– The Web Development Workshop, the first pre-hackathon session of Hack Revolution. Before the hackathon begins, step into the world of web technologies and learn how to turn your ideas into dynamic, creative, and functional web solutions.
highlights: Get Ready to Build the Web of Tomorrow!
Turn ideas into dynamic web solutions

title: SIH Decoded – Hear it from the Winners!
subtitle: Guidance for Smart India Hackathon
description: Want to Participate in SIH but need guidance? Hear it from the Winners! In 2024, Two CSI teams from MJCET Won SIH. Now, they’re here to share how they did it. Whether you’re curious about hackathons, planning to participate in SIH, or just want to learn from the winners, this session is for you! Fee: ₹50 (Free for CSI Members).
highlights: PS Selection Tips – how to choose the right problem statement
Guide to making a Winning PPT
Journey from PS selection to the finale
